indication: Chronic kidney disease associated with type 1 diabetes: new indication to reduce urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio (FINE-ONE)
headline: KERENDIA (finerenone) approved for a third U.S. indication, chronic kidney disease associated with type 1 diabetes, on September 16, 2026 (FDA letter); Bayer announced it on September 17.
pdufa_note: Bayer never published a PDUFA goal date for this supplemental application: its May 21, 2026 release states FDA acceptance and Priority Review only. The FDA's approval letter for NDA 215341/S-011 is dated September 16, 2026 (Drugs@FDA), which is the decision date; Bayer's release is dated September 17. Because no sponsor-stated goal date exists, no early/late margin is published for this decision. The sNDA was submitted March 16, 2026 and is based on the Phase III FINE-ONE study (242 adults; 25% reduction in UACR versus placebo over six months).
